references.title: What to expect from an interior designer
references.finding: Houzz asks clients to establish scope, budget, material samples, illustrations, a work schedule, progress meetings and site inspections. Applied here: a recorded brief, separate room sheets, finish codes, an item list and visible review decisions. A website cannot replace site inspection or project management.

references.title: Beautiful Homes — interior service presentation
references.finding: Asian Paints presents room-specific interiors, modular kitchen/wardrobe choices, customization and 3D visualization before purchase. Applied here: room-by-room exploration and coordinated material/item schedules. This is a presentation reference, not a product endorsement, price quote or claim of local service availability.

references.title: Jammu: the yearly climate
references.finding: 1991–2020 table reports June mean daily high 38.3°C, January mean daily low 7.3°C, and July rain 416.5 mm. Primary IMD PDF retrieval failed; this distinction is explicit.

references.title: IMD climate services
references.finding: Official climate-service index was accessible. It links climate information and IMD Pune services. Its current-weather pages do not substitute for yearly normals.

references.title: Tenang House — KSD Studio
references.finding: The Mumbai living room uses a low curved neutral sofa, two visually light wood armchairs, full-height sheers and very little open display. Applied here: a calm neutral base, mixed seating and clear sightlines. Its dimensions and Jammu climate performance are unknown.

references.title: Eklavya House — KSD Studio
references.finding: The Mumbai room pairs light neutral seating with strong greenery and one controlled blue accent. Applied here: restrained colour and connection to planting. Its large unshaded glass areas are not copied because Jammu solar gain must be checked.

references.title: Mandir — The Eka Designs
references.finding: The Delhi mandir uses symmetry, warm concealed light, marble and carved wood. Applied here: symmetry and warm task light. Heavy ornament is simplified for your compact 4 by 5 foot puja and minimal preference.

references.title: Safe cot placement for your babies
references.finding: Room sharing uses a separate infant sleep space near the parents. Use a firm, flat, level surface with a fitted sheet and no loose bedding, pillows or cot bumpers. The 3D cots are layout placeholders, not fabrication specifications.

solarGeometry.source: Jammu latitude from retrieved Wikipedia page; spherical solar-geometry calculation
solarGeometry.model: Level horizon, solar centre at zero elevation; ignores refraction, terrain and buildings
solarGeometry.interpretation: Approximate summer sunset aligns with the NW rear; winter sunrise is near the SE front. This supports adjustable shading rather than permanently closing rear glazing. Actual obstruction survey is required.
